units: seconds, milliseconds, bytes as named; RSS KiB; CPU percent of one logical core
notes: Network counts are server writes; cancelled-body overdelivery is possible.
Rebuffer grouping uses >=500ms timeline plateaus with network/cache corroboration. Decode stalls remain a possible confound; inspect phase progress and queues.
Packet non-forward bytes are total minus forward estimates, not precise allocator ownership.
No raw byte-cache count is converted to seconds.
